title: Luscious Velvety Turkish Pecan Adana Kebap
description: A vegan-friendly Turkish dish featuring pecan nuts, this Adana kebap is a perfect comfort food for a sick day, with a rich umami flavor and velvety texture, served on a slate tile.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped pecan nuts, crumbled tofu, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the olive oil and lemon juice to the bowl and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired kebap size, and shape each piece into a long, thin cylinder.
Place the kebaps in the air fryer basket, leaving some space between each kebap for even cooking.
Cook the kebaps in the air fryer for 12-15 minutes, or until they are golden brown and crispy on the outside, and cooked through.
Remove the kebaps from the air fryer and place them on a slate tile to serve.
Serve the kebaps hot, garnished with additional chopped pecan nuts and a squeeze of lemon juice if desired.
